args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the unhealthy release — it should be investigated before any future redeploy attempt.
